name: Self-Control
overview: The sample verses from Joshua 7 reveal that self-control is essential for obedience to God's covenant and the spiritual health of His people. Israel's failure to exercise discipline by taking the accursed thing led to their defeat and God's withdrawal of favor until the sin was removed. This teaches that self-control involves sanctifying ourselves and removing sin from our midst to stand firm against enemies, highlighting the necessity of both personal and communal discipline.
